it.Ziele:\nBelastungsverträglichkeit umfang:
Obiettivi:
Costruire la tolleranza al carico in modo ampio e variato e consolidare le basi atletiche (coordinazione, mobilità, forza di base).

Contenuto:
Allenamento atletico polisportivo (~6.4 h/settimana) con scuola di corsa, salti, esercizi a corpo libero, allenamento tecnico con il bilanciere e prime sedute di skiroll per imparare i movimenti di base di classico e skating.
it.Ziele:\nTrainingsgrundlagen breit aufbau:
Obiettivi:
Costruire ampiamente le basi dell'allenamento, aumentare volume e frequenza e promuovere la versatilità tra gli sport.

Contenuto:
Allenamento atletico incentrato su tecnica del bilanciere, stabilità del tronco e prime forme di salto (~6.2 h/settimana), combinato con bici, corsa, nuoto e sport complementari come atletica o ginnastica.

Obiettivi:
Costruire ampiamente le basi dell'allenamento e aumentare volume e frequenza a un livello nettamente superiore.

Contenuto:
Allenamento atletico polisportivo con tecnica del bilanciere, stabilità del tronco e scuola di salto (~7.7 h/settimana), combinato con bici, corsa, nuoto e sport complementari come bike, atletica o ginnastica.
it.Ziele:\nKonditionelle Grundlagen breit u:
Obiettivi:
Costruire le basi condizionali in modo ampio e duraturo e aumentare volume e frequenza a un livello elevato.

Contenuto:
Allenamento atletico polisportivo (~9.1 h/settimana) incentrato su efficienza funzionale, tecnica del bilanciere, pliometria e forza del tronco, combinato con resistenza di base in bici, nella corsa e sugli skiroll a intensità da bassa a media.

Obiettivi:
Costruire le basi condizionali in modo ampio e duraturo e aumentare volume e frequenza a un livello elevato.

Contenuto:
Ampio allenamento atletico (~9.8 h/settimana) incentrato su efficienza funzionale, tecnica del bilanciere, pliometria e forza del tronco, combinato con resistenza di base in bici, nella corsa e sugli skiroll a intensità da bassa a media.

Obiettivi:
Costruire le basi condizionali in modo ampio e duraturo a un volume elevato (18–22 h/settimana).

Contenuto:
Allenamento di resistenza a piedi e sugli skiroll, completato da bici, canottaggio e nuoto, combinato con due sedute intensive alla settimana (I4/I5) e allenamento atletico (~11.7 h/settimana) incentrato su tecnica del bilanciere, pliometria e forza del tronco.

Obiettivi:
Costruire le basi condizionali in modo ampio e duraturo al massimo volume (18–22 h/settimana).

Contenuto:
Allenamento di resistenza a piedi e sugli skiroll, completato da bici, canottaggio e nuoto, combinato con due sedute intensive alla settimana (I4/I5) e allenamento atletico (~13.4 h/settimana) incentrato su tecnica del bilanciere, pliometria e forza del tronco.
it.Ziele:\nKonditionelle Grundlagen auf Wel:
Obiettivi:
Sviluppare le basi condizionali a livello mondiale e sviluppare in modo mirato le esigenze individuali.

Contenuto:
Allenamento di resistenza ad alto volume a piedi e sugli skiroll con attrezzi di allenamento specifici, completato da bici, canottaggio e nuoto e allenamento atletico (~14.2 h/settimana) incentrato su tecnica del bilanciere, pliometria e forza del tronco.
it.Ziele:\nSportartspezifische Bewegungsqua:
Obiettivi:
Consolidare la qualità del movimento specifica dello sport sugli skiroll e sfruttare in modo mirato le finestre di velocità/agilità.

Contenuto:
Quota maggiore di skiroll (classico e skating) con focus su spinta delle gambe, doppia spinta e tecnica 1:2, completata da forme di sprint, coordinazione e salto e allenamento della forza più avanzato.
it.Ziele:\nGrundlagenausdauer (I1) und spor:
Obiettivi:
Consolidare la resistenza di base (I1) e la tecnica specifica dello sport, e sviluppare in modo mirato velocità e sviluppo muscolare.

Contenuto:
Sedute di resistenza strutturate (corsa in montagna e cross, bici 60–120'), skiroll con focus tecnico, sviluppo muscolare, inizio dell'allenamento della forza esplosiva e forza del tronco.
it.Ziele:\nGrundlagenausdauer (I1), sportar:
Obiettivi:
Sviluppare in modo mirato la resistenza di base (I1), la tecnica specifica dello sport e lo sviluppo muscolare, e sfruttare la velocità secondo la window of opportunity (soprattutto nei ragazzi).

Contenuto:
Sedute di resistenza strutturate (corsa in montagna e cross, bici 60–120'), skiroll con focus tecnico, sviluppo muscolare, inizio dell'allenamento della forza esplosiva e forza del tronco.
it.Ziele:\nSchwellen-, Kapazitäts- und Maxi:
Obiettivi:
Sviluppare in modo mirato forza di soglia, capacità e forza massima, e affinare il profilo individuale dell'atleta.

Contenuto:
Blocchi di soglia strutturati (I2/I3) completati da allenamento della capacità, ipertrofia muscolare e allenamento di coordinazione intramuscolare, combinati con la tecnica dello skiroll e le prime gare nazionali di skiroll.

Obiettivi:
Sviluppare in modo mirato forza di soglia, capacità e forza massima, e continuare ad affinare il profilo individuale dell'atleta.

Contenuto:
Blocchi di soglia strutturati (I2/I3) completati da allenamento della capacità, ipertrofia muscolare e allenamento di coordinazione intramuscolare, combinati con la tecnica dello skiroll, 2–4 gare nazionali di skiroll e gare di allenamento di sci di fondo.
it.Ziele:\nVO₂max und Grundlagenausdauer ge:
Obiettivi:
Sviluppare in modo mirato VO₂max e resistenza di base, e continuare a sviluppare ipertrofia muscolare e forza massima.

Contenuto:
Allenamento di resistenza e a intervalli sulla pista da skiroll, completato da gare estive (1–2 gare di skiroll, gare di allenamento di sci di fondo), allenamento di coordinazione intramuscolare e forza esplosiva con carichi aggiuntivi.

Obiettivi:
Sviluppare in modo mirato VO₂max e resistenza di base, e continuare a sviluppare ipertrofia muscolare e forza massima.

Contenuto:
Allenamento di resistenza e a intervalli sulla pista da skiroll, completato da 2–4 gare di skiroll nazionali/internazionali e gare di allenamento di sci di fondo, allenamento di coordinazione intramuscolare e forza esplosiva con carichi aggiuntivi.
it.Ziele:\nVO₂max, Laktattoleranz und Schwe:
Obiettivi:
Sviluppare VO₂max, tolleranza al lattato e velocità di soglia a livello mondiale, e continuare a sviluppare ipertrofia muscolare e forza massima.

Contenuto:
Allenamento di resistenza e a intervalli sulla pista da skiroll, completato da 2–4 gare di skiroll nazionali/internazionali e gare di allenamento di sci di fondo, allenamento di coordinazione intramuscolare e forza esplosiva con carichi aggiuntivi.
it.Ziele:\nÜbergang vom Rollski auf Schnees:
Obiettivi:
Riuscire la transizione dallo skiroll alla neve e stabilire un movimento ludico e sicuro sugli sci di fondo (classico e skating).

Contenuto:
Primi allenamenti sulla neve con forme di gioco (lavaggio degli elefanti, acchiapparella dell'ospedale, skills park), tecniche di base (passo alternato, spina di pesce, passo a curva, 1:2) e mantenimento dell'atletica con sedute brevi e intensive e salti variati.
it.Ziele:\nTechnik auf Rollski und Schnee v:
Obiettivi:
Affinare la tecnica sugli skiroll e sulla neve e preparare la transizione alla stagione sulla neve.

Contenuto:
Percorsi tecnici sugli skiroll, corsa con bastoncini su terreno mosso, giochi e staffette, allenamento della forza esplosiva e della forza del tronco.

Obiettivi:
Affinare la tecnica sugli skiroll e sulla neve, sviluppare la forza esplosiva e preparare la transizione alla stagione sulla neve.

Contenuto:
Percorsi tecnici sugli skiroll, corsa con bastoncini su terreno mosso, giochi e staffette, allenamento della forza esplosiva e della forza del tronco.
it.Ziele:\nCForm über kurze Intervalle steu:
Obiettivi:
Gestire la forma con intervalli brevi e portare forza massima e forza veloce al livello stagionale.

Contenuto:
Prosecuzione di tutte le forme di allenamento con accento su intervalli brevi, forza veloce ed esplosiva con e senza carico aggiuntivo, e transizione sulla neve con focus tecnico.
it.Ziele:\nForm über kurze Intervalle steue:
Obiettivi:
Gestire la forma con intervalli brevi e portare forza massima e forza veloce al livello stagionale.

Contenuto:
Prosecuzione di tutte le forme di allenamento con accento su intervalli brevi, forza veloce ed esplosiva con e senza carico aggiuntivo, e transizione sulla neve con focus tecnico.
it.Ziele:\nRennintensität und VO₂max auf We:
Obiettivi:
Portare l'intensità di gara e il VO₂max a livello di competizione e adattarli sulla neve.

Contenuto:
Allenamento sulla neve e sugli sci con intervalli a ritmo gara, completato da allenamento della forza rapida ed esplosiva e forza del tronco.

Obiettivi:
Portare l'intensità di gara e il VO₂max a livello di Coppa del Mondo e adattarli sulla neve.

Contenuto:
Allenamento sulla neve e sugli sci con intervalli a ritmo gara, completato da allenamento della forza rapida ed esplosiva e forza del tronco.
it.Ziele:\nTempohärte und Hochgeschwindigke:
Obiettivi:
Portare la resistenza al ritmo e la tecnica ad alta velocità a livello di Coppa del Mondo e adattarle sulla neve.

Contenuto:
Allenamento sulla neve e sugli sci con intervalli a ritmo gara, completato da allenamento della forza rapida ed esplosiva e forza del tronco.
it.Ziele:\nErste Wettkampferfahrungen in ei:
Obiettivi:
Fare le prime esperienze di gara in un ambiente gioioso e orientato all'apprendimento, e applicare sulla neve la qualità del movimento costruita in estate.

Contenuto:
Allenamento regolare sulla neve con varietà tecnica, partecipazione ad animazioni locali/regionali e alla Swiss Nordic Trophy, completato da allenamento atletico ridotto (~2.6 h/settimana) per il mantenimento della forza e la prevenzione degli infortuni.
it.Ziele:\nDie rund sechs Monate Schneezeit:
Obiettivi:
Sfruttare intensamente i circa sei mesi sulla neve per l'allenamento tecnico e di base, e fare esperienza attraverso gare regionali.

Contenuto:
Molto tempo sugli sci con focus su tecnica, discese, giochi e coordinazione, completato da allenamento atletico e del tronco di mantenimento (~2.6 h/settimana), allenamento della forza esplosiva e pliometria ridotti.

Obiettivi:
Sfruttare intensamente i circa sei mesi sulla neve per l'allenamento tecnico e di base, e fare esperienza attraverso gare regionali e internazionali.

Contenuto:
Molto tempo sugli sci con focus su tecnica, discese, giochi e coordinazione, completato da allenamento atletico e del tronco di mantenimento (~2.6 h/settimana), allenamento della forza esplosiva e pliometria con volume ridotto.

Obiettivi:
Sfruttare i circa sei mesi sulla neve per la gestione della forma e della prestazione in un calendario di gare fitto.

Contenuto:
Molto tempo sugli sci con allenamento di base e tecnico nonostante cali di prestazione, gestione della forma con intervalli brevi e combinati, allenamento atletico, di forza esplosiva e massima di mantenimento (~2.6 h/settimana) con volume adattato alle gare.

Obiettivi:
Sfruttare i circa sei mesi sulla neve per una gestione mirata della forma e della prestazione nel fitto calendario internazionale di gare.

Contenuto:
Molto tempo sugli sci con allenamento di base e tecnico nonostante cali di prestazione, gestione della forma con intervalli brevi e combinati, allenamento atletico, di forza esplosiva e massima di mantenimento (~3.3 h/settimana) con volume adattato alle gare.
it.Ziele:\nWettkampfleistung im internation:
Obiettivi:
Esprimere la prestazione in gara nel calendario internazionale e gestire la forma con un tapering mirato.

Contenuto:
Allenamento sugli sci orientato alla gara con gestione individuale del carico, combinato con allenamento atletico, di forza esplosiva e massima di mantenimento (~3.8 h/settimana) a intensità costante e volume adattato alle gare.

Obiettivi:
Esprimere la prestazione in gara nel calendario internazionale di alto livello e gestire la forma con un tapering mirato.

Contenuto:
Allenamento sugli sci orientato alla gara con gestione individuale del carico, combinato con allenamento atletico, di forza esplosiva e massima di mantenimento (~4.3 h/settimana) a intensità costante e volume adattato alle gare.

Obiettivi:
Esprimere costantemente la prestazione in gara nel calendario internazionale di alto livello e gestire la forma con un tapering mirato.

Contenuto:
Allenamento sugli sci orientato alla gara con gestione del carico altamente individualizzata, combinato con allenamento atletico, di forza esplosiva e massima di mantenimento (~4.6 h/settimana) a intensità costante e volume adattato alle gare.

it.Ziele: Schaffung einer kräftigen und wid:
Obiettivi: sviluppare una muscolatura forte e resistente. Costruire una buona base aerobica. Promuovere le capacità coordinative. Variazione dei metodi di allenamento. Sviluppo della tecnica

Contenuto: allenamento tecnico di salto con gli sci (diverse forme di allenamento), strength endurance (senza pesi, numero elevato di ripetizioni), sviluppo muscolare (pesi moderati, ca. dieci ripetizioni), pliometria (numero elevato di ripetizioni). Sedute di resistenza leggere (corsa, bici, inline). Prevenzione degli infortuni (stabilità dell'asse delle gambe, mobilità, forza del tronco, rafforzamento degli ischiocrurali), allenamento variato con focus su coordinazione e forza.

it.Ziele: Aufbau von Schnelligkeit, Schnell:
Obiettivi: sviluppare velocità, forza rapida ed esplosiva. Trasferire la resistenza di base in forme di intervalli brevi e ludici, equilibrio tra recupero e carico. Sviluppo della tecnica

Contenuto: allenamento tecnico di salto con gli sci (specifico, numero elevato di ripetizioni), forme di sprint, pliometria (forme di salto, numero basso di ripetizioni), sviluppo della forza (numero medio-basso di ripetizioni, poco peso), corse a intervalli, integrare in modo mirato fasi di recupero (vacanze scolastiche).
Prevenzione degli infortuni (stabilità dell'asse delle gambe, mobilità, forza del tronco, rafforzamento degli ischiocrurali), allenamento specifico con focus sulla tecnica.

Obiettivi: sviluppare velocità, forza rapida ed esplosiva. Equilibrio tra recupero e carico. Ottimizzazione della tecnica

Contenuto: allenamento tecnico di salto con gli sci (specifico, numero elevato di ripetizioni), forme di sprint, pliometria (forme di salto, numero basso di ripetizioni), sviluppo della forza massima (pesi da alti a massimi, numero medio-basso di ripetizioni), corse a intervalli, integrare in modo mirato fasi di recupero. Prevenzione degli infortuni (stabilità dell'asse delle gambe, mobilità, forza del tronco, rafforzamento degli ischiocrurali), allenamento specifico con focus sulla tecnica.
it.Ziele: Erhaltung der Schnell- und Explos:
Obiettivi: mantenere la forza veloce ed esplosiva. Restare sani e mentalmente forti.

Contenuto: pliometria (forme di salto, numero basso di ripetizioni), sviluppo della forza veloce (numero basso di ripetizioni), allenamento di coordinazione (sci di fondo), focus su allenamento di stabilizzazione, mobilizzazione e imitazione.

Obiettivi: mantenere la forza rapida ed esplosiva. Restare sani e mentalmente forti. Qualità prima della quantità. Transfer dal trampolino estivo a quello invernale

Contenuto: pliometria (forme di salto, numero basso di ripetizioni), sviluppo della forza massima (pesi da alti a massimi, numero medio-basso di ripetizioni), imitazioni, focus su freddezza e precisione.
it.Ziele: Freude am Konkurrenzkampf entwick:
Obiettivi: sviluppare il piacere della competizione, mantenere l'allenamento di forza e velocità, bilanciare recupero e carico. Più salti sulla neve possibile (sfruttare le fasi ricche di neve).

Contenuto: allenamento di forza e velocità. Portare le prestazioni di allenamento in gara.
Obiettivi: le gare guidano l'allenamento. Priorizzazione delle gare (importante, media, secondaria). Pianificare i blocchi di allenamento tenendo conto del recupero, mantenere l'allenamento di forza e velocità, bilanciare recupero e carico.

Contenuto: preparazione mirata alle gare. Allenamento di forza e velocità. Chiare fasi di recupero.

• Adattamento del volume alle gare
• L'intensità resta invariata

it.Ziele: Muskulatur stark und widerstandsf:
Obiettivi: rendere la muscolatura forte e resistente. Migliorare la tecnica del bilanciere. Costruire una buona base aerobica. Promuovere le capacità coordinative. Variazione dei metodi di allenamento.

Contenuto: strength endurance (pesi leggeri, numero elevato di ripetizioni), sviluppo muscolare (pesi moderati, ca. dieci ripetizioni), verso la fine di questa fase allenamento della forza massima. Pliometria (numero elevato di ripetizioni). Sedute di resistenza lunghe e leggere (bici, corsa, inline). Allenamento variato con focus su coordinazione, forza e resistenza.
it.Ziele: Aufbau von Schnelligkeit, Schnell:
Obiettivi: sviluppare velocità, forza rapida ed esplosiva. Trasferire la resistenza di base in forme di intervalli intensivi, equilibrio tra recupero e carico.

Contenuto: forme di sprint, pliometria (forme di salto, numero basso di ripetizioni), sviluppo della forza (pesi alti, numero medio-basso di ripetizioni), corse a intervalli e resistenza di base, integrare in modo mirato fasi di recupero
it.Ziele: Erhaltung der Schnell- und Explos:
Obiettivi: mantenere la forza rapida ed esplosiva. Sfruttare l'allenamento sulla neve per la trasposizione coordinativa delle capacità condizionali. Restare sani e mentalmente forti.

Contenuto: allenamento sulla neve con un volume elevato di manche di allenamento. Simulazioni di gara. Focus su freddezza e precisione. Resistenza di base per il recupero. Allenamento di mantenimento nella forza.

en.Ziele:\nKörperliche und mentale Erholung:
Goals:
Ensure physical and mental recovery after the competition season and revive the joy of multi-sport movement.

Content:
Unstructured, playful everyday movement (cycling, swimming, game sports) with clearly reduced training volume and no biathlon-specific content (shooting paused).
en.Ziele:\nErholung von der Wettkampfsaison:
Goals:
Ensure recovery from the competition season and keep the joy of sport alive through multi-sport movement.

Content:
Unstructured, varied activities without biathlon-specific content (cycling, swimming, game sports) at clearly reduced volume; shooting training paused.
en.Ziele:\nKörperliche und mentale Erholung:
Goals:
Ensure physical and mental recovery after the competition season and maintain training enjoyment through multi-sport movement.

Content:
Unstructured, varied activities without biathlon-specific content (cycling, swimming, game sports) at clearly reduced volume; shooting training paused.

Goals:
Ensure physical and mental recovery after the intensive competition season and prevent load monotony through multi-sport movement.

Content:
Unstructured, varied activities without biathlon-specific content (cycling, swimming, game sports) at clearly reduced volume and low intensity; shooting training paused.

Goals:
Ensure physical and mental recovery after the intensive competition season and prevent load monotony and overtraining.

Content:
Unstructured, varied activities without biathlon-specific content (cycling, swimming, game sports) at clearly reduced volume and low intensity; shooting training paused.

Goals:
Ensure physical and mental recovery after the international competition season and prevent overtraining.

Content:
Unstructured, varied activities without biathlon-specific content (cycling, swimming, game sports) at clearly reduced volume and low intensity; shooting training paused.

Goals:
Ensure physical and mental recovery after the World Cup season and prevent overtraining at the highest load level.

Content:
Unstructured, varied activities without biathlon-specific content (cycling, swimming, game sports) at clearly reduced volume and low intensity; shooting training paused.
en.Ziele:\nBelastungsverträglichkeit umfang:
Goals:
Build load tolerance extensively and in varied ways, consolidate athletic basics (coordination, mobility, basic strength) and introduce shooting playfully.

Content:
Multi-sport athletic training (~6.4 h/week) with running drills, jumps, bodyweight exercises, barbell technique and first roller-ski sessions to learn basic classic and skating movements, complemented by playful shooting forms with the air rifle.
en.Ziele:\nTrainingsgrundlagen breit aufbau:
Goals:
Broadly build training foundations, increase volume and frequency, encourage cross-sport versatility and develop basic shooting technique (position, breathing, trigger) with the air rifle.

Content:
Athletic training focusing on barbell technique, core stability and first jump forms (~6.2 h/week), combined with cycling, running, swimming and complementary sports such as athletics or gymnastics, plus regular air-rifle shooting training prone and standing.

Goals:
Broadly build training foundations, raise volume and frequency to a clearly higher level and automate shooting technique with the small-bore rifle.

Content:
Multi-sport athletic training with barbell technique, core stability and jump school (~7.7 h/week), combined with cycling, running, swimming and complementary sports, plus systematic small-bore shooting training (position, pressure point, trigger control) prone and standing.
en.Ziele:\nKonditionelle Grundlagen breit u:
Goals:
Build conditioning foundations broadly and sustainably, increase volume and frequency at a high level and refine technical shooting elements with the small-bore rifle.

Content:
Multi-sport athletic training (~9.1 h/week) focusing on functional efficiency, barbell technique, plyometrics and core strength, combined with base endurance on the bike, running and roller skis at low to medium intensity, plus smooth re-cocking and stable trigger control in shooting training.

Goals:
Build conditioning foundations broadly and sustainably, increase volume and frequency at a high level and further refine technical shooting elements.

Content:
Extensive athletic training (~9.8 h/week) focusing on functional efficiency, barbell technique, plyometrics and core strength, combined with base endurance on the bike, running and roller skis at low to medium intensity, plus refinement of prone and standing shooting technique.

Goals:
Build conditioning foundations at a high volume level (18–22 h/week) broadly and sustainably and automate technical shooting elements.

Content:
Endurance training on foot and on roller skis, complemented by cycling, rowing and swimming, combined with two intensive sessions per week (I4/I5), athletic training (~11.7 h/week) focusing on barbell technique, plyometrics and core strength, plus high-frequency shooting training to automate technique.

Goals:
Build conditioning foundations at the highest volume level (18–22 h/week) broadly and sustainably and automate technical shooting elements.

Content:
Endurance training on foot and on roller skis, complemented by cycling, rowing and swimming, combined with two intensive sessions per week (I4/I5), athletic training (~13.4 h/week) focusing on barbell technique, plyometrics and core strength, plus high-frequency shooting training to automate technique.
en.Ziele:\nKonditionelle Grundlagen auf Wel:
Goals:
Develop conditioning foundations to world-class level, target individual needs and automate shooting technique under competition conditions.

Content:
High-volume endurance training on foot and on roller skis with specific training devices, complemented by cycling, rowing and swimming, athletic training (~14.2 h/week) focusing on barbell technique, plyometrics and core strength, plus individualised shooting training at the highest frequency.
en.Ziele:\nSportartspezifische Bewegungsqua:
Goals:
Consolidate sport-specific movement quality on roller skis, use the speed/agility windows deliberately and take up the shooting position confidently.

Content:
Increased share of roller skiing (classic and skating) focusing on leg push, double poling and 1:2 technique, complemented by sprint, coordination and jump forms, advanced strength training and regular shooting training focused on position stability.
en.Ziele:\nGrundlagenausdauer (I1) und spor:
Goals:
Consolidate base endurance (I1) and sport-specific technique, develop speed and muscle mass deliberately and increasingly combine shooting with physical load.

Content:
Structured endurance sessions (mountain and cross running, cycling 60–120'), roller skiing with technique focus plus muscle building, first explosive strength work, core strength and shooting training with first combined running/shooting forms.
en.Ziele:\nGrundlagenausdauer (I1), sportar:
Goals:
Deliberately develop base endurance (I1), sport-specific technique and muscle mass, use speed according to the window of opportunity (especially in boys) and improve shooting precision under load.

Content:
Structured endurance sessions (mountain and cross running, cycling 60–120'), roller skiing with technique focus, muscle building, first explosive strength work and core strength, plus regular combined running/roller-ski + shooting sessions.
en.Ziele:\nSchwellen-, Kapazitäts- und Maxi:
Goals:
Deliberately develop threshold, capacity and maximum strength, sharpen the individual athlete profile and increase shooting speed and precision under load.

Content:
Structured threshold blocks (I2/I3) complemented by capacity training, muscle hypertrophy and intramuscular coordination training, combined with roller-ski technique, first summer competitions (Swiss Biathlon Cup) and combined sessions focusing on shooting speed and 30/30 precision.

Goals:
Deliberately develop threshold, capacity and maximum strength, further sharpen the individual athlete profile and increase shooting speed and precision under competition load.

Content:
Structured threshold blocks (I2/I3) complemented by capacity training, muscle hypertrophy and intramuscular coordination training, combined with roller-ski technique, summer competitions (Swiss Biathlon Cup, IBU Junior Cup) and combined sessions with shooting speed and 30/30 precision.
en.Ziele:\nVO₂max und Grundlagenausdauer ge:
Goals:
Deliberately develop VO₂max and base endurance, further build muscle hypertrophy and maximum strength and standardise shooting speed.

Content:
Endurance and interval training on the roller-ski track, complemented by summer competitions (Swiss Biathlon Cup, IBU Cup), intramuscular coordination training and explosive strength with additional weights, plus high-intensity combined sessions (running/roller skis + shooting) with standardised shooting speed.

Goals:
Deliberately develop VO₂max and base endurance, further build muscle hypertrophy and maximum strength and standardise shooting speed.

Content:
Endurance and interval training on the roller-ski track, complemented by national/international summer competitions (IBU Summer World Cup, Swiss Biathlon Cup), intramuscular coordination training and explosive strength with additional weights, plus high-intensity combined sessions with standardised shooting speed.
en.Ziele:\nVO₂max, Laktattoleranz und Schwe:
Goals:
Develop VO₂max, lactate tolerance and threshold speed to world-class level, further build muscle hypertrophy and maximum strength and secure shooting speed under World Cup conditions.

Content:
Endurance and interval training on the roller-ski track, complemented by national/international summer competitions, intramuscular coordination training and explosive strength with additional weights, plus individualised combined sessions at World Cup shooting speed.
en.Ziele:\nÜbergang vom Rollski auf Schnee:
Goals:
Manage the transition from roller skis to snow, establish playful, confident movement on cross-country skis (classic and skating) and automate the switch from skiing to shooting.

Content:
First on-snow sessions with game forms (elephant wash, tag games, skills park), basic techniques (diagonal stride, herringbone, step turning, 1:2), maintaining athleticism through short, intensive sessions and varied jumps, plus first combined skiing + shooting forms at the biathlon facility.
en.Ziele:\nTechnik auf Rollski und Schnee v:
Goals:
Refine technique on roller skis and snow, prepare the transition to the snow season and stabilise shooting under skiing load.

Content:
Technique courses on roller skis, running with poles in rolling terrain, games and relays, explosive strength and core strength training, plus combined skiing + shooting sessions focused on a stable position technique after load.

Goals:
Refine technique on roller skis and snow, develop explosive strength, prepare the transition to the snow season and stabilise shooting speed under skiing load.

Content:
Technique courses on roller skis, running with poles in rolling terrain, games and relays, explosive strength and core strength training, plus combined skiing + shooting sessions focused on shooting speed and precision.
en.Ziele:\nForm über kurze Intervalle steue:
Goals:
Control form through short intervals, bring maximum and speed strength to season level and secure shooting performance under competition conditions.

Content:
Continuation of all training forms with emphasis on short intervals, speed and explosive strength with and without additional weight, transition to snow with technique focus, plus competition-like combined sessions focused on shooting stability and speed.

Goals:
Control form through short intervals, bring maximum and speed strength to season level and secure shooting performance under competition conditions.

Content:
Continuation of all training forms with emphasis on short intervals, speed and explosive strength with and without additional weight, transition to snow with technique focus, plus competition-like combined sessions focused on shooting stability and speed.
en.Ziele:\nRennintensität und VO₂max auf We:
Goals:
Bring race intensity and VO₂max to competition level, adapt to snow and secure shooting performance at race pace.

Content:
On-snow and ski training with race-pace intervals, complemented by speed and explosive strength training, core strength, plus competition-like combined sessions with shooting performance at race pace.

Goals:
Bring race intensity and VO₂max to World Cup level, adapt to snow and secure shooting performance under World Cup conditions.

Content:
On-snow and ski training with race-pace intervals, complemented by speed and explosive strength training, core strength, plus competition-like combined sessions with shooting performance at World Cup pace.
en.Ziele:\nTempohärte und Hochgeschwindigke:
Goals:
Bring pace endurance and high-speed technique to World Cup level, adapt to snow and keep shooting performance constant under World Cup conditions.

Content:
On-snow and ski training with race-pace intervals, complemented by speed and explosive strength training, core strength, plus individualised combined sessions with constant shooting performance at World Cup pace.
en.Ziele:\nErste Wettkampferfahrungen in ei:
Goals:
Gather first competition experience in a joyful, learning-oriented environment, apply the movement quality built in summer on snow and experience shooting in competition.

Content:
Regular on-snow training with technical variety, participation in the Swiss Biathlon Cup - Kids and local events, complemented by reduced athletic training (~2.6 h/week) for strength maintenance and injury prevention, plus competition-like shooting exercises.
en.Ziele:\nDie rund sechs Monate Schneezeit:
Goals:
Use the roughly six months on snow intensively for technique and basics, gain experience through regional competitions and consolidate shooting in competition.

Content:
Lots of time on skis focusing on technique, downhills, games and coordination, complemented by maintenance athletic and core training (~2.6 h/week), reduced explosive strength training, plyometrics and national-level competitions.

Goals:
Use the roughly six months on snow intensively for technique and basics, gain experience through regional and international competitions and consolidate shooting performance in competition.

Content:
Lots of time on skis focusing on technique, downhills, games and coordination, complemented by maintenance athletic and core training (~2.6 h/week), explosive strength and plyometrics at reduced volume, plus national-level competitions and first international starts.

Goals:
Use the roughly six months on snow for form and performance management in a dense competition calendar and stabilise shooting performance in international competition.

Content:
Lots of time on skis with base and technique training despite performance dips, form control through short and combined intervals, maintenance athletic, explosive and maximum strength training (~2.6 h/week) with volume adapted to competitions, plus starts in international competitions.

Goals:
Use the roughly six months on snow for targeted form and performance management in the dense international calendar and stabilise shooting performance in international competition.

Content:
Lots of time on skis with base and technique training despite performance dips, form control through short and combined intervals, maintenance athletic, explosive and maximum strength training (~3.3 h/week) with volume adapted to competitions, plus starts in international competitions and series.
en.Ziele:\nWettkampfleistung im internation:
Goals:
Deliver competition performance in the international calendar, control form through targeted tapering and keep shooting performance constant under World Cup conditions.

Content:
Competition-oriented ski training with individual load management, combined with maintenance athletic, explosive and maximum strength training (~3.8 h/week) at constant intensity and volume adapted to competitions, plus World Cup starts.

Goals:
Deliver competition performance in the top international calendar, control form through targeted tapering and keep shooting performance constant under World Cup conditions.

Content:
Competition-oriented ski training with individual load management, combined with maintenance athletic, explosive and maximum strength training (~4.3 h/week) at constant intensity and volume adapted to competitions, plus starts in the World Cup, at World Championships and at the Olympic Games.

Goals:
Consistently deliver performance in the top international calendar, control form through targeted tapering and produce shooting performance at the highest level under World Cup conditions.

Content:
Competition-oriented ski training with highly individualised load management, combined with maintenance athletic, explosive and maximum strength training (~4.6 h/week) at constant intensity and volume adapted to competitions, plus starts in the World Cup, at World Championships and at the Olympic Games.

en.Ziel\nFörderung gesunder Gewohnheiten im:
Goal
Promote healthy everyday habits. Involve parents with tips or workshops.

Implement the sports bag checklist
Water bottle, snack box and change of clothes.

Build conscious snack and drink breaks into training
Give explanations (per hour of training = 500 ml of water or diluted juice)

Cooking as a team
Joint snack preparation or cooking classes.
en.Ziel\nGrundverständnis für ausgewogene E:
Goal
Basic understanding of balanced nutrition. Promote healthy everyday habits. Link between nutrition, energy for sport and school.

Balanced diet
½ vegetables/fruit, ¼ carbohydrates, ¼ protein at every meal.

Drinking
Water as the main drink, approx. 1.5–2 l daily, more when training.

Regular meals
Breakfast, lunch, dinner and 2 healthy snacks (e.g. fruit, nuts).

Preparation
Bring snacks and water bottle to training.
en.Ziel\nBewusstheit und Anpassung stärken:
Goal
Strengthen awareness and adaptation, deepen understanding of macronutrients (carbohydrates, protein, fat) and fluid needs.

Before training
Drink approx. 500 ml of water 1–2h beforehand. In heat or with high salt loss use slightly salty drinks (1 pinch of salt).

During training
Drink 150–200 ml every 15–20'; for efforts >1h add carbohydrates (e.g. diluted fruit juices, carbohydrate-rich drinks).

After training

Sleep duration

Routine
Same bedtimes, also at weekends.

Relaxation

en.Regelmässige Schlafzeiten\nEntspannungsr:
Regular sleep times
Build in relaxation rituals

Thought stop
Get up if awake for a long time. Write down thoughts to clear the mind. Turn negative thoughts about sleep into positive beliefs.

Optimised use of caffeine and aids
Consider the effect (half-life 6h, stronger effect in adolescents), avoid at least 6h before sleep. Use eye masks, ear protection, etc.

Plan power naps
Short naps of 10–15' for recovery, ideally after lunch.

Adjustments for travel and competitions
Adapt sleep and meal times to time zone changes. Use strategies against jet lag.

Targeted, individual sleep optimisation secures long-term performance.

Regular sleep routines and adaptation to travel or competitions are decisive.

en.Ziel\nBewusstheit und Anpassung stärken:
Goal
Strengthen awareness and adaptation; deepen understanding of macronutrients (carbohydrates, protein, fat) and fluid needs.

Before training
Drink approx. 500 ml of water 1–2h beforehand. In heat or with high salt loss, use lightly salted drinks (1 pinch of salt).

During training
Drink 150–200 ml every 15–20'; for efforts >1h add carbohydrates (e.g. diluted fruit juices).

After training
0.5-1 l of fluid within 30'. For intense efforts use electrolyte drinks or lightly salted water.

en.Regelmässige Schlafzeiten\nEntspannungsr:
Regular sleep times
Build in relaxation rituals

Rumination stop
Get up if awake for a long time. Write down thoughts to clear your head. Turn negative thoughts about sleep into positive beliefs.

Optimised use of caffeine and aids
Consider the effect (half-life 6h, stronger effect in adolescents), avoid at least 6h before sleep. Use eye masks, ear protection, etc.

Plan power naps
Short naps of 10–15' for recovery, ideally after lunch.

Adjustments for travel and competitions
Adapt sleep and meal times to time zone changes. Use strategies against jet lag.
en.Eine gezielte und individuelle Schlafopt:
Targeted and individual sleep optimisation secures long-term performance.

Regular sleep routines and adapting to travel or competitions are decisive.

Sleep problems should be monitored and treated if necessary. Power naps and relaxation techniques such as the rumination stop promote recovery and mental calm.

Ensure physical and mental recovery after the competition season and revive the joy of multi-sport movement.

Unstructured, playful movement in everyday life (cycling, swimming, game sports) with clearly reduced training volume and without cross-country-specific content.
en.Ziele:\nErholung von der Wettkampfsaison:
Goals:
Ensure recovery from the competition season and maintain the joy of sport through multi-sport movement.

Content:
Unstructured, varied activities without cross-country-specific content (cycling, swimming, game sports) with clearly reduced volume.
en.Ziele:\nKörperliche und mentale Erholung:
Goals:
Ensure physical and mental recovery after the competition season and maintain training enjoyment through multi-sport movement.

Content:
Unstructured, varied activities without cross-country-specific content (cycling, swimming, game sports) at clearly reduced volume.

Goals:

Ensure physical and mental recovery after the intensive competition season and prevent load monotony and overtraining.

Content:
Unstructured, varied activities without cross-country-specific content (cycling, swimming, game sports) at clearly reduced volume and low intensity.

Goals:

Unstructured, varied activities without cross-country-specific content (cycling, swimming, game sports) at clearly reduced volume and low intensity.

Content:

en.Ziele:\nBelastungsverträglichkeit umfang:
Goals:
Build load tolerance extensively and in a varied way, and consolidate athletic basics (coordination, mobility, basic strength).

Content:
Multi-sport athletic training (~6.4 h/week) with running drills, jumps, bodyweight exercises, barbell technique training as well as first roller ski sessions to learn basic classic and skating movements.
en.Ziele:\nTrainingsgrundlagen breit aufbau:
Goals:
Build broad training foundations, increase volume and frequency, and encourage cross-sport versatility.

Content:
Athletic training focusing on barbell technique, core stability and first jump forms (~6.2 h/week), combined with cycling, running, swimming and complementary sports such as athletics or gymnastics.

Goals:
Build broad training foundations and increase volume and frequency to a clearly higher level.

Content:
Multi-sport athletic training with barbell technique, core stability and jump school (~7.7 h/week), combined with cycling, running, swimming and complementary sports such as biking, athletics or gymnastics.
en.Ziele:\nKonditionelle Grundlagen breit u:
Goals:
Build conditioning foundations broadly and sustainably and increase volume and frequency at a high level.

Content:
Multi-sport athletic training (~9.1 h/week) focusing on functional efficiency, barbell technique, plyometrics and core strength, combined with base endurance on the bike, running and roller skis at low to medium intensity.

Goals:
Build conditioning foundations broadly and sustainably and increase volume and frequency at a high level.

Content:
Extensive athletic training (~9.8 h/week) focusing on functional efficiency, barbell technique, plyometrics and core strength, combined with base endurance on the bike, running and roller skis at low to medium intensity.

Goals:
Build conditioning foundations broadly and sustainably at a high volume level (18–22 h/week).

Content:
Endurance training on foot and on roller skis, supplemented by cycling, rowing and swimming, combined with two intensive sessions per week (I4/I5) and athletic training (~11.7 h/week) focusing on barbell technique, plyometrics and core strength.

Goals:
Build conditioning foundations broadly and sustainably at the highest volume level (18–22 h/week).

Content:
Endurance training on foot and on roller skis, supplemented by cycling, rowing and swimming, combined with two intensive sessions per week (I4/I5) and athletic training (~13.4 h/week) focusing on barbell technique, plyometrics and core strength.
en.Ziele:\nKonditionelle Grundlagen auf Wel:
Goals:
Develop conditioning foundations at world-class level and specifically develop individual needs.

Content:
High-volume endurance training on foot and on roller skis with specific training equipment, supplemented by cycling, rowing and swimming as well as athletic training (~14.2 h/week) focusing on barbell technique, plyometrics and core strength.
en.Ziele:\nSportartspezifische Bewegungsqua:
Goals:
Consolidate sport-specific movement quality on roller skis and specifically use the speed/agility windows.

Content:
Increased share of roller skiing (classic and skating) with focus on leg push-off, double poling and 1:2 technique, supplemented by sprint, coordination and jump forms as well as more advanced strength training.
en.Ziele:\nGrundlagenausdauer (I1) und spor:
Goals:
Consolidate base endurance (I1) and sport-specific technique, and specifically develop speed and muscle growth.

Content:
Structured endurance sessions (mountain and cross running, cycling 60–120'), roller skiing with technique focus as well as muscle building, beginning explosive strength training and core strength.
en.Ziele:\nGrundlagenausdauer (I1), sportar:
Goals:
Specifically develop base endurance (I1), sport-specific technique and muscle growth, and use speed according to the window of opportunity (especially in boys).

Content:
Structured endurance sessions (mountain and cross running, cycling 60–120'), roller skiing with technique focus as well as muscle building, beginning explosive strength training and core strength.
en.Ziele:\nSchwellen-, Kapazitäts- und Maxi:
Goals:
Specifically develop threshold, capacity and maximum strength, and sharpen the individual athlete profile.

Content:
Structured threshold blocks (I2/I3) supplemented by capacity training, muscle hypertrophy and intramuscular coordination training, combined with roller ski technique and first national roller ski races.

Goals:
Specifically develop threshold, capacity and maximum strength, and further sharpen the individual athlete profile.

Content:
Structured threshold blocks (I2/I3) supplemented by capacity training, muscle hypertrophy and intramuscular coordination training, combined with roller ski technique as well as 2–4 national roller ski races and cross-country training races.
en.Ziele:\nVO₂max und Grundlagenausdauer ge:
Goals:
Specifically develop VO₂max and base endurance, and further build muscle hypertrophy and maximum strength.

Content:
Endurance and interval training on the roller ski track, supplemented by summer competitions (1–2 roller ski races, cross-country training races) as well as intramuscular coordination training and explosive strength training with additional loads.

Goals:
Specifically develop VO₂max and base endurance, and further build muscle hypertrophy and maximum strength.

Content:
Endurance and interval training on the roller ski track, supplemented by 2–4 national/international roller ski races and cross-country training races as well as intramuscular coordination training and explosive strength training with additional loads.
en.Ziele:\nVO₂max, Laktattoleranz und Schwe:
Goals:
Develop VO₂max, lactate tolerance and threshold speed at world-class level, and further build muscle hypertrophy and maximum strength.

Content:
Endurance and interval training on the roller ski track, supplemented by 2–4 national/international roller ski races and cross-country training races as well as intramuscular coordination training and explosive strength training with additional loads.
en.Ziele:\nÜbergang vom Rollski auf Schnees:
Goals:
Manage the transition from roller skis to snow and establish playful, safe movement on cross-country skis (classic and skating).

Content:
First snow sessions with game forms (elephant washing, hospital tag, skills park), basic techniques (diagonal stride, herringbone, step turning, 1:2) as well as maintaining athletics through short, intensive sessions and varied jumps.
en.Ziele:\nTechnik auf Rollski und Schnee v:
Goals:
Refine technique on roller skis and snow and prepare the transition to the snow season.

Content:
Technique courses on roller skis, running with poles in rolling terrain, games and relays as well as explosive strength and core strength training.

Goals:
Refine technique on roller skis and snow, develop explosive strength and prepare the transition to the snow season.

Content:
Technique courses on roller skis, running with poles in rolling terrain, games and relays as well as explosive strength and core strength training.
en.Ziele:\nCForm über kurze Intervalle steu:
Goals:
Manage form through short intervals and bring maximum and speed strength to season level.

Content:
Continuation of all training forms with emphasis on short intervals, speed and explosive strength with and without additional load, and transition to snow with technique focus.
en.Ziele:\nForm über kurze Intervalle steue:
Goals:
Manage form through short intervals and bring maximum and speed strength to season level.

Content:
Continuation of all training forms with emphasis on short intervals, speed and explosive strength with and without additional load, and transition to snow with technique focus.
en.Ziele:\nRennintensität und VO₂max auf We:
Goals:
Bring race intensity and VO₂max to competition level and adapt them on snow.

Content:
Training on snow and skis with race-pace intervals, supplemented by speed and explosive strength training as well as core strength.

Goals:
Bring race intensity and VO₂max to World Cup level and adapt them on snow.

Content:
Training on snow and skis with race-pace intervals, supplemented by speed and explosive strength training as well as core strength.
en.Ziele:\nTempohärte und Hochgeschwindigke:
Goals:
Bring pace endurance and high-speed technique to World Cup level and adapt them on snow.

Content:
Training on snow and skis with race-pace intervals, supplemented by speed and explosive strength training as well as core strength.
en.Ziele:\nErste Wettkampferfahrungen in ei:
Goals:
Gain first competition experience in a joyful, learning-oriented environment and apply the movement quality built up in summer on snow.

Content:
Regular snow training with technical variety, participation in local/regional events and the Swiss Nordic Trophy, supplemented by reduced athletic training (~2.6 h/week) for strength maintenance and injury prevention.
en.Ziele:\nDie rund sechs Monate Schneezeit:
Goals:
Use the roughly six months of snow time intensively for technique and foundation training and gain experience through regional competitions.

Content:
Lots of time on skis focusing on technique, descents, games and coordination, supplemented by maintaining athletic and core training (~2.6 h/week) as well as reduced explosive strength training and plyometrics.

Goals:
Use the roughly six months of snow time intensively for technique and foundation training and gain experience through regional and international competitions.

Content:
Lots of time on skis focusing on technique, descents, games and coordination, supplemented by maintaining athletic and core training (~2.6 h/week) as well as explosive strength training and plyometrics at reduced volume.

Goals:
Use the roughly six months of snow time for form and performance management in a dense competition calendar.

Content:
Lots of time on skis with foundation and technique training despite performance dips, form management through short and combined intervals as well as maintaining athletic, explosive and maximum strength training (~2.6 h/week) with volume adapted to competitions.

Goals:
Use the roughly six months of snow time for targeted form and performance management in the dense international competition calendar.

Content:
Lots of time on skis with foundation and technique training despite performance dips, form management through short and combined intervals as well as maintaining athletic, explosive and maximum strength training (~3.3 h/week) with volume adapted to competitions.
en.Ziele:\nWettkampfleistung im internation:
Goals:
Deliver competition performance in the international calendar and manage form through targeted tapering.

Content:
Competition-oriented ski training with individual load management, combined with maintaining athletic, explosive and maximum strength training (~3.8 h/week) at constant intensity and volume adapted to competitions.

Goals:
Deliver competition performance in the top international calendar and manage form through targeted tapering.

Content:
Competition-oriented ski training with individual load management, combined with maintaining athletic, explosive and maximum strength training (~4.3 h/week) at constant intensity and volume adapted to competitions.

Goals:
Consistently deliver competition performance in the top international calendar and manage form through targeted tapering.

Content:
Competition-oriented ski training with highly individualised load management, combined with maintaining athletic, explosive and maximum strength training (~4.6 h/week) at constant intensity and volume adapted to competitions.

en.Ziele: Muskulatur stark und widerstandsf:
Goals: make the musculature strong and resilient. Improve barbell technique. Develop a good aerobic base. Promote coordinative abilities. Variation of training methods.

Content: strength endurance (light weights, high repetition count), muscle building (moderate weights, approx. ten repetitions), maximum strength training towards the end of this phase. Plyometrics (high repetition count). Long, easy endurance sessions (cycling, running, inline). Varied training focusing on coordination, strength and endurance.
en.Ziele: Aufbau von Schnelligkeit, Schnell:
Goals: build speed, speed strength and explosive strength. Transfer base endurance into intensive interval forms, balance between recovery and load.

Content: sprint forms, plyometrics (jump forms, low repetition count), strength building (high weights, medium to low repetition counts), interval runs and base endurance, deliberately include recovery phases
en.Ziele: Erhaltung der Schnell- und Explos:
Goals: maintain speed and explosive strength. Use snow training for the coordinative implementation of conditioning abilities. Stay healthy and mentally strong.

Content: snow training with a high volume of training runs. Competition simulations. Focus on coolness and precision. Base endurance for recovery. Maintenance strength training.

Practise different (snow) sports
Move extensively & experience-oriented
Improve basic movement & game forms

Foster creativity & independence

On Snow:
- Acquire the specific basics (Racing Basics 1-3) of alpine skiing.
- Acquire & consolidate general basics (Basic Air)
- Skiing in a kids cross.

Off Snow:
- Endurance: maintain an active daily life and build load tolerance (extensive, varied and challenging).
- Mobility/flexibility: optimise joint & muscle mobility.
- Strength: learn technique and posture.
- Speed/agility: golden age from 8 to 13 years. Always train fresh and at maximum intensity.
